ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ABM Knowledgeware Limited has filed a routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The document confirms that all physical securities received for dematerialization were duly processed, mutilated, and cancelled, with depositories updated as registered owners within the stipulated timelines. This indicates sound operational compliance regarding share transfer activities, with no material adverse impacts or red flags identified.
